_comment: ASSISTANT-PROPOSED labels, NOT human-reviewed. For each sample question, the rule number(s) whose text I read and judged to decide the question (see data/evaluation/sample_questions.md). Use them as a regression signal for retrieval, not as ground truth. A legal reviewer should confirm or correct them (docs/evaluation.md). An empty expect_any means the rules do not answer and the system must abstain.
